note: Levels and stars for Dorian's games. The live unlock numbers are K.UNLOCK in js/kinder/levels.js (goodShare 0.8, roundsInARow 2, rightInARow 5). This file mirrors them; loadLevels copies the constant over these values. A round is good when at least goodShare of it was right on the first try with no hint. The next level opens after roundsForStar good rounds in a row, OR rightInARow right answers in a row inside one round, whichever comes first. A grown-up can open the next level on the parent page. Warm-up rounds do not count toward stars. Each round is 10 questions.
